help: Post delays, snow days and early dismissals here. Every student's extension checks this file about every 15 minutes, and whenever a student opens the popup (GitHub can take up to 5 more), and their timers switch to the right bells.
Add one entry per day to the days list below. Past days are ignored, so you never need to clean up.

schedule can be: delay1 (1-hour delay), delay2 (2-hour delay), homeroom (15-minute homeroom), early (early dismissal, also needs a dismissal time like 11:00), closed (no school), or regular (to undo something).
message is optional and shows in the popup, e.g. 2-hour delay due to snow.
Separate entries with commas, but put no comma after the last one. After you commit, check the Actions tab: a green check means the file is valid.
